<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru" class="scroll-smooth dark">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>IAT VPN — Быстрый и простой VPN</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      darkMode: 'class',
      theme: {
        extend: {
          fontFamily: {
            sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'],
            mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace'],
          }
        }
      }
    }
  </script>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
      background-color: #060b16;
      color: #f1f5f9;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }
    .glass {
      background: rgba(10, 18, 36, 0.75);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14);
    }
    .glass-card {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15, 29, 56, 0.6) 0%, rgba(9, 16, 32, 0.85) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16);
      transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }
    .glass-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -10px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.22);
    }
    .glow-bg {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.24) 0%, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08) 42%, transparent 72%);
    }
    .logo-glow {
      box-shadow: 0 0 60px -10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
    }
    /* Кастомный тонкий скроллбар */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: rgba(6, 11, 22, 0.5);
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
      border-radius: 9999px;
      transition: background 0.2s ease, width 0.2s ease;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
    }
    /* Кнопка "Наверх" */
    #scrollToTopBtn {
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(10px);
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      z-index: 99999;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    #scrollToTopBtn.show {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between selection:bg-sky-500 selection:text-white">

  <!-- Ambient Glow -->
  <div class="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none glow-bg z-0"></div>

  <!-- Header -->
  <header class="sticky top-0 z-40 glass">
    <div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 h-16 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <a href="#hero" class="flex items-center gap-3 group focus:outline-none">
        <img id="headerLogo" src="" alt="IAT VPN Logo" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl object-cover border border-sky-400/30 shadow-md shadow-sky-500/20 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform" />
        <span id="brandNameDisplay" class="font-extrabold text-lg tracking-tight text-white">IAT VPN</span>
      </a>

      <nav class="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-6 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
        <a href="#features" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">Преимущества</a>
        <a href="#apps" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">Устройства</a>
        <a href="#faq" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">Вопросы</a>
      </nav>

      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button type="button" id="openKeyModalBtn" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-sky-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/25 transition-all">
          Подключить
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="relative z-10 flex-1">
    <!-- HERO SECTION -->
    <section id="hero" class="pt-12 pb-14 sm:pt-20 sm:pb-20 px-4 sm:px-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center">
      <!-- Uploaded Brand Logo Showcase -->
      <div class="flex justify-center mb-7">
        <div class="relative p-1.5 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-400/40 to-blue-600/10 logo-glow">
          <img id="heroLogo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="IAT VPN" class="w-32 h-32 sm:w-40 sm:h-40 rounded-2xl object-cover max-w-full" />
        </div>
      </div>

      <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white leading-tight">
        Быстрый и простой <span class="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-400 to-cyan-300">VPN в один клик</span>
      </h1>

      <p class="text-sm sm:text-lg text-slate-300 max-w-xl mx-auto mt-4 leading-relaxed">
        Твой реактивный ускоритель для YouTube в 4K и любимых сайтов. Без турбулентности и сложных настроек.
      </p>

      <div class="mt-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-3.5">
        <button type="button" id="heroGetAccessBtn" class="w-full sm:w-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl text-base font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-sky-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-white shadow-xl shadow-sky-500/25 transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]">
          <span>Получить ключ доступа</span>
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6" />
          </svg>
        </button>

        <a href="#apps" class="w-full sm:w-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-7 py-4 rounded-2xl text-base font-semibold bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-100 border border-slate-700 transition-all">
          <span>Скачать приложение</span>
        </a>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- COMPACT FEATURES -->
    <section id="features" class="py-10 sm:py-14 px-4 sm:px-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
        <div class="glass-card rounded-2xl p-6 text-center">
          <div class="w-11 h-11 mx-auto rounded-xl bg-sky-500/15 border border-sky-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-sky-400 mb-3">
            <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-white">Высокая скорость</h2>
          <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 mt-1.5">Видео в 4K, игры и звонки работают плавно и без задержек.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="glass-card rounded-2xl p-6 text-center">
          <div class="w-11 h-11 mx-auto rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400 mb-3">
            <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-white">Полная защита</h2>
          <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 mt-1.5">Современное шифрование и полное отсутствие логов.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="glass-card rounded-2xl p-6 text-center">
          <div class="w-11 h-11 mx-auto rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-400 mb-3">
            <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9.75 17L9 20l-1 1h8l-1-1-.75-3M3 13h18M5 17h14a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-white">Для всех устройств</h2>
          <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-400 mt-1.5">Поддержка Android, IOS, Windows, Mac OS.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- SIMPLE SETUP SECTION -->
    <section id="apps" class="py-10 sm:py-14 px-4 sm:px-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
      <div class="text-center mb-7">
        <h2 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white">Подключение за 30 секунд</h2>
        <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1">Выберите ваше устройство</p>
      </div>

      <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2 mb-6" role="tablist">
        <button type="button" data-os="ios" class="os-tab-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-sky-500 text-white transition-all">🍎 iPhone / iPad</button>
        <button type="button" data-os="android" class="os-tab-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-slate-800/90 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all">🤖 Android</button>
        <button type="button" data-os="windows" class="os-tab-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-slate-800/90 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all">🪟 Windows</button>
        <button type="button" data-os="macos" class="os-tab-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-slate-800/90 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all">💻 macOS</button>
      </div>

      <div id="osCardContainer" class="glass-card rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7">
        <!-- Populated by JS -->
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- COMPACT FAQ -->
    <section id="faq" class="py-10 sm:py-14 px-4 sm:px-6 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
      <h2 class="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-extrabold text-white text-center mb-6">Частые вопросы</h2>
      <div class="space-y-3">
        <div class="glass-card rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
          <button type="button" class="faq-toggle w-full px-5 py-4 text-left flex items-center justify-between gap-4 font-semibold text-white text-sm">
            <span>Как подключиться к VPN?</span>
            <span class="faq-icon text-sky-400 text-lg font-bold">+</span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq-content hidden px-5 pb-4 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300">
            Нажмите на синию ссылку или отсканируйте qr code рядом с ней для оплаты и дальнейших инструкций.
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="glass-card rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
          <button type="button" class="faq-toggle w-full px-5 py-4 text-left flex items-center justify-between gap-4 font-semibold text-white text-sm">
            <span>Можно ли использовать на нескольких устройствах?</span>
            <span class="faq-icon text-sky-400 text-lg font-bold">+</span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq-content hidden px-5 pb-4 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300">
            По ссылке ниже вы можете ознакомиться с условиями каждого тарифа.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <!-- FOOTER -->
  <footer class="border-t border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-950/80 py-7 px-4 sm:px-6 relative z-10">
    <div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <img id="footerLogo" src="" alt="IAT VPN" class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg object-cover border border-sky-400/30" />
        <span class="font-bold text-sm text-white">IAT VPN</span>
        <span class="text-xs text-slate-500"> 2026</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-slate-400">
        <button type="button" id="footerSupportBtn" class="hover:text-white transition-colors">Поддержка в Telegram</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <!-- SIMPLE ACCESS KEY MODAL (NO PAYMENT) -->
  <div id="keyModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md">
    <div class="glass-card rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl relative">
      <button type="button" id="closeKeyModalBtn" class="absolute top-4 right-4 w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 hover:text-white" aria-label="Закрыть">
        ✕
      </button>

      <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
        <img id="modalLogo" src="" alt="IAT VPN" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl object-cover border border-sky-400/30" />
        <div>
          <h3 class="text-lg font-extrabold text-white">Ваш ключ IAT VPN</h3>
          <p class="text-xs text-emerald-400 font-medium">Готов к подключению</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
        Скопируйте ключ ниже и добавьте его из буфера обмена в приложение <strong>v2rayTun</strong> или <strong>Hiddify</strong>:
      </p>

      <div class="mt-3 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800">
        <div id="generatedKeyText" class="font-mono text-xs text-sky-300 break-all select-all">
          vless://iat-fast-key@connect.iatvpn.net:443?security=reality&amp;sni=cloudflare.com#IAT-VPN
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mt-4 flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" id="copyKeyBtn" class="flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-sky-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-white transition-all">
          Скопировать ключ
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Toast -->
  <div id="toastBox" class="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 hidden px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/95 border border-sky-500/40 text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium shadow-2xl items-center gap-2">
    <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>
    <span id="toastMessage">Готово!</span>
  </div>

  <script>
    const osGuides = {
      ios: {
        title: 'iPhone и iPad',
        app: 'v2rayTun или Streisand (App Store)',
        steps: ['Скачайте приложение в App Store.', 'Скопируйте ключ и нажмите «Добавить из буфера».']
      },
      android: {
        title: 'Android',
        app: 'v2rayTun или Hiddify (Google Play)',
        steps: ['Установите приложение из Google Play.', 'Нажмите «+» → «Импорт из буфера обмена».']
      },
      windows: {
        title: 'Windows 10 / 11',
        app: 'Hiddify Next',
        steps: ['Скачайте и откройте программу Hiddify.', 'Нажмите «Новый профиль» → «Добавить из буфера».']
      },
      macos: {
        title: 'macOS',
        app: 'v2rayTun или Hiddify',
        steps: ['Установите приложение из App Store.', 'Импортируйте скопированный ключ в один клик.']
      }
    };

    let activeOs = 'ios';
    let toastTimer = null;

    function showToast(msg) {
      const box = document.getElementById('toastBox');
      document.getElementById('toastMessage').textContent = msg;
      box.classList.remove('hidden');
      box.classList.add('flex');
      if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
      toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        box.classList.add('hidden');
        box.classList.remove('flex');
      }, 2800);
    }

    function openKeyModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('keyModal');
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function renderOsGuide() {
      const g = osGuides[activeOs];
      const container = document.getElementById('osCardContainer');
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-5 border-b border-slate-800/80">
          <div>
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-white">${g.title}</h3>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Приложение: <strong class="text-sky-300">${g.app}</strong></p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" id="osGetKeyBtn" class="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-white transition-colors shrink-0">
            Скопировать ключ
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5 mt-5">
          ${g.steps.map((s, i) => `
            <div class="bg-slate-900/70 border border-slate-800/90 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-start gap-3">
              <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">${i + 1}</span>
              <span class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-200">${s}</span>
            </div>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
      document.getElementById('osGetKeyBtn').addEventListener('click', openKeyModal);
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      // Share single inlined logo across header, footer, and modal
      const logoSrc = document.getElementById('heroLogo').getAttribute('src');
      document.getElementById('headerLogo').setAttribute('src', logoSrc);
      document.getElementById('footerLogo').setAttribute('src', logoSrc);
      document.getElementById('modalLogo').setAttribute('src', logoSrc);

      renderOsGuide();

      document.getElementById('openKeyModalBtn').addEventListener('click', openKeyModal);
      document.getElementById('heroGetAccessBtn').addEventListener('click', openKeyModal);
      document.getElementById('closeKeyModalBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('keyModal');
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      });

      document.getElementById('copyKeyBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const keyText = document.getElementById('generatedKeyText').textContent.trim();
        const fallback = (str) => {
          const el = document.createElement('textarea');
          el.value = str;
          document.body.appendChild(el);
          el.select();
          document.execCommand('copy');
          document.body.removeChild(el);
        };
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(keyText).catch(() => fallback(keyText));
        } else {
          fallback(keyText);
        }
        showToast('📋 Ключ скопирован в буфер обмена!');
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.os-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          activeOs = btn.getAttribute('data-os');
          document.querySelectorAll('.os-tab-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.className = 'os-tab-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-slate-800/90 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all';
          });
          btn.className = 'os-tab-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-sky-500 text-white transition-all';
          renderOsGuide();
        });
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-toggle').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const content = btn.nextElementSibling;
          const icon = btn.querySelector('.faq-icon');
          const isHidden = content.classList.contains('hidden');
          content.classList.toggle('hidden');
          icon.textContent = isHidden ? '−' : '+';
        });
      });

      document.getElementById('footerSupportBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        showToast('💬 Поддержка в Telegram: @iat_vpn_support');
      });
    });
  </script>
  <!-- Кнопка возврата наверх -->
  <button type="button" id="scrollToTopBtn" aria-label="Наверх" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-sky-400/20 text-sky-400 shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/10 hover:bg-sky-500 hover:text-white hover:border-sky-400 transition-all group">
    <svg class="w-5 h-5 group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 15l7-7 7 7"></path>
    </svg>
  </button>

  <script>
    const scrollToTopBtn = document.getElementById('scrollToTopBtn');

    // Показываем кнопку, когда прокрутили вниз больше чем на 300 пикселей
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 300) {
        scrollToTopBtn.classList.add('show');
      } else {
        scrollToTopBtn.classList.remove('show');
      }
    });

    // Плавный скролл наверх при клике
    scrollToTopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
